title: About
text:
Now. Director of Data & Analytics at 412 Food Rescue, which runs the Food Rescue Hero platform used by food rescue organizations across North America. As the organization’s dedicated data lead, I cover BI, data engineering, geospatial analysis, statistical modeling, and ML.
Before. 
Education. University of Pittsburgh, School of Public and International Affairs. 
Tools. R (tidyverse, fixest, sf), Python (pandas, geopandas, pyfixest), SQL/Postgres, Observable JS, MapLibre.
Elsewhere. Treasurer, National Food Recovery Association executive board.

title: Sean Hudson
text: I build data systems and analyses for food rescue: measuring community need, mapping food access, and helping a national network of partners understand their impact. I work mostly in R, increasingly in Python, and like analyses that end in a decision someone can act on.
